run_kinematics: run kinematics to convert position and velocity from generalized coordinates to maximal coordinates
compute_com_pos: compute center of mass position and map inertias to the global frame centered at subtree-CoM
run_crb: run composite rigid body inertia algorithm to compute the joint-space inertia matrix qM
solve_m: solve sparse backsubstitution to compute x = inv(L'*D*L)*y for the inertia matrix factorization
run_rne: run recursive Newton-Euler inverse dynamics to compute bias forces qfrc_bias
